A growing company in Oklahoma City is hiring for the position of Cost Accounting Manager. This position will play an integral role within the company including heading up an accounting department and strategic decision making. This position is a great opportunity to join a great corporate culture and obtain excellent benefits.

Requirements Of Cost Accounting Manager

General ledger and fixed assets5+ Years of cost accounting highly preferred including job costing, project costing, labor costing, materials costingPrevious supervisory or management experience preferredBachelor Degree required - preferably in AccountingManufacturing experience required

Compensation Of Cost Accounting Manager

Base salary $100,000 - $130,000 dependent on education and experience. To apply, please visit www.fuse3solutions.com.
